decisions.summary: Stockline raised its price to 0.05, which is over our 0.03 mandate cap and leaves zero margin, so I stopped buying from it. Ridgeline (0.04, 0.01 margin) is also over the cap. I set the policy to cache-only (up to 300 s old) and asked Treasury to raise the per-purchase cap to 0.04 for Ridgeline; no purchases until the CFO decides.

Sourcing is blocked (0.03 cap is below every supplier price), so I sent the CFO a rebalance as P-0001 and P-0002. It differs from what Sourcing asked for: the recommended option raises the price to 0.06, the cap to 0.05 and Sourcing's budget to 12.00, total 20.00. I also swept the 0.89 net earnings to Airwallex (S-1, final) and told Sourcing what was proposed.

No change this wake. Market is unchanged: Stockline is at 0.05 (zero margin) and Ridgeline at 0.04 (0.01 margin), both above my 0.03 per-purchase cap. The buy policy stays cache-only (serve cached stock checks up to 300 s old) while the CFO decides on the mandate request (P-0001 recommended, or P-0002). I'm not buying anything until the cap or price is raised.

Market unchanged: Stockline 0.05 (zero margin) and Ridgeline 0.04 (0.01 margin), both above the 0.03 mandate cap. Keeping the cache-only policy (serve cached stock checks up to 300 s old) and making no purchases until the CFO decides on the cap-raise request.

I did nothing this wake. The 3 customers turned away (event #4) are the same block I already sent to the CFO as P-0001 and P-0002, which are still waiting, so a second rebalance would only duplicate them. The ledger shows INV-2026-1043 as paid and no other invoices are open, so there's nothing to plan. I'm holding the 0.70 net earnings on Metal until the CFO decides on the rebalance, since a new mandate could change what has to stay there.

Market is unchanged: Stockline is at 0.05 (zero margin) and Ridgeline at 0.04 (0.01 margin), both above my 0.03 per-purchase cap, so buying would breach the mandate. I'm keeping the cache-only policy (serve cached stock checks up to 300 s old) and making no purchases while the CFO decides on the cap-raise request.

Packwise Starter is ending this month, so I bought the Pro plan (45.00 EUR) on the Airwallex card to keep warehouse sync running; approved. Stock-data policy unchanged: still cache-only (up to 300 s) because Stockline (0.05) and Ridgeline (0.04) are above the 0.03 mandate cap, pending the CFO's decision on the cap-raise request.

Ran settle_dispute for D-aff1679b. Orders #7–#10 were refunded at 0.05 each, 0.20 in total, within the automatic limits. The tool reported that the supplier's correction showed 0 parkas in stock where each stock check showed 12. Nothing needed escalating to the CFO.

I tried to plan Stockline invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 216.00, due 15 Nov), but code stopped it because the licence fee it has on record is EUR 240.00. A person needs to check the contract before this invoice is planned, so nothing went to the CFO and no money moved. I didn't send a second rebalance: the 5 turned-away queries are the same block P-0001 and P-0002 already cover, and both are still with the CFO. I'm keeping the 0.50 net earnings on Metal until the CFO decides, since a new mandate could change what has to stay there.

I took no action. The new 25.00 EUR payment came from an unknown payer and is waiting in suspense for the CFO to identify. SLL-2026-11 still needs someone to check the contract (EUR 216.00 on the invoice, 240.00 on record). The rebalance (P-0001 and P-0002) is still with the CFO, and I'm keeping the 0.50 net earnings on Metal until it's decided.

messages.text: Sourcing: Stockline now charges 0.05 per stock check (sell price 0.05, zero margin), so I won't buy from it. Ridgeline Data charges 0.04 (data 5 min old, margin 0.01, 13 of last 20 paid, 7 unavailable). Our mandate cap is 0.03, so no supplier is buyable now. Request: raise the per-purchase cap to 0.04 (Ridgeline only), budget unchanged at 9.94. Until the CFO decides I am serving from cache only, no purchases.

Treasury: I sent your mandate request to the CFO as P-0001 (Option A) and P-0002 (Option B). Option A is the recommended one: query price up from 0.05 to 0.06, your cap up to 0.05, and your budget up to 12.00 with 2.00 moved from Treasury. Total stays 20.00. That makes Stockline pay 0.01 a check and keeps Ridgeline (0.04, failed 7 of its last 20) as a backup. Option B sets the price at 0.08. Please keep serving from cache only until the CFO signs. Also, I swept 0.89 to Airwallex (S-1).
